g.text: Supported: a native-editable, section-aligned workspace with testable gates.Open: reading-and-recall evaluation and bespoke diagrams
From one-way automation to a workflow authors can inspect, navigate, and revise; the paper names the limits of its own proxies
Five composable skills, one bundle, three native-editable artifacts
One Paper2Assets bundle feeds a native-editable PowerPoint poster and video deck and abilingual Word blog; Paper2Reel binds their sections, slides, video times, captions, andpassages.
Posters judged above the authors' own on aesthetics

Best among automated systems on all three aesthetic sub-criteria and best or tied-best on twoof three information sub-criteria under two VLM judges; 3.56 vs 3.03; overall wins on 74 and 95of 100 papers.

The delivery-contract pattern may extend to other targets with native authoring formats,deterministic renderers, and testable package criteria — with its evaluative, generative, andarchitectural limits still to be studied (§6).
TWO GAPS THAT MATTER MORE THAN COVERAGE

The aesthetic rubric and PaperQuiz pull in opposite directions — a denser posterwins comprehension while a cleaner one wins aesthetics — and neithermeasures whether a reader absorbs the work. The measured-fill loop optimizes ageometric density target, not understanding; the honest next step is to close theloop on a controlled human reading-and-recall signal rather than on a proxy adenser poster can always game.

Because the pipeline reuses only figures that already exist in the paper, it cannotyet produce the bespoke method or overview diagrams human designers add tocarry the narrative. Addressing this may require faithful figure synthesis, whichreintroduces the hallucination risk the categorical gates were built to suppress,and would push gate discipline from layout onto the factual content of generatedvisuals.
“By keeping generated artifacts editable and connected after generation, ResearchStudio-Reel shifts the last mile from one-way automation toward a workflow authorscan inspect, navigate, and revise.”
